elements.label: Mystery of the Worm
elements.description: “I will be as pervasive as a worm.”

elements.label: Ligeia
elements.description: Twins share one-seventh of the named.

elements.label: Nectar
elements.description: An evergreen treasure in the world's veins; the pulse of the turning seasons. [Long ago, some called this principle 'Blood'.]

elements.label: Dweller in the Woods
elements.description: Make friends with the mountains and forests, with rivers by their side. [Allies with this aspect do not get injured from 'Sleeping in the Wild']

elements.label: Shrine: Mother of Ants
elements.description: Mother of Ants, as a saint, is known for her pious pursuit of asceticism. Her faith dominates the church.

elements.label: Faith
elements.description: “If he does not doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says will come to pass, it will be done for him.” — Mark 11:23

elements.label: Shadow of the Mother of Ants
elements.description: The merciful mother appears from our wounds, soothes our pain, and opens more possibilities for us.

elements.label: Shadow of the Thunderskin
elements.description: Rolling thunder and storms in the sky, deafening drumbeats from unknown sources, soldiers performing strange dances of beauty and ritual during rest... He is nearby, or rather, he is here.

elements.label: Deadly Poison
elements.description: Little Sister contains powerful Knock within her; be careful not to be bitten by them.....[Allies injured by Little Sister will be poisoned]

elements.label: Poisoned
elements.description: Poison runs rampant in the flesh... [Poisoned allies lose two points of Edge. You can use 'Raw Venom' to cure them.]

elements.label: Mother of Ants' 'Mercy'
elements.description: The elder sister was born among serpents; the younger sister responds to her, so the elder sister protects the younger.

elements.label: Fire
elements.description: Fire is harsh winter, yet it carries warmth; fire is warm spring, yet it consumes all.

elements.label: Raw Venom
elements.description: Mother of Ants is sometimes called 'Daughter of Venom'. This substance opens the body in countless places. [You can use it to cure poisoning]

elements.label: Emblem of Saint Agony
elements.description: Saint Agony of Bohemia is known for her pious pursuit of asceticism. The emblem is terrifying in shape.

elements.label: Stained Gloves
elements.description: What were they once used for? What could they teach my hands?

elements.label: Scarred Leg Bone
elements.description: Present it when another devourer arrives. Until then, ensure we remain ourselves.
